question: Estimate the number of Indians using AI for tax filing (chatbots, auto-fill ITR apps) by 2027.
idealClarificationQuestions: Self-filing taxpayers using AI-assisted tools (TaxBuddy AI, ClearTax AI bot, etc.)? Yes.
Or AI-only filing (no human CA)? AI-assisted.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total individual taxpayers → those who self-file → AI tool penetration.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, self-filing (vs CA-filing): ~40% = 32M (rising due to ClearTax, Tax2Win).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Drivers to 2027: ClearTax/Quicko AI launches, Income Tax portal AI helper rollout, ChatGPT used informally for tax queries.

calculationFlow: Of these, self-filing (vs CA-filing): ~40% = 32M (rising due to ClearTax, Tax2Win).
Of self-filers, using app/portal with AI assistance (auto-fill, chatbot help): ~25-30% in 2026 = ~9M.
